The retrieved context doesn't include the starter example itself, so I can't confirm its exact code. The closest documentation is the persistence guide, which shows the save call and the default directory:

"storage_context.persist(persist_dir="<persist_dir>")" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/storing/save_load.md]

"This will persist data to disk, under the specified `persist_dir` (or `./storage` by default)." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/storing/save_load.md]

So the save call is `storage_context.persist()`, and if no `persist_dir` is given, the directory is `./storage`. A separate tutorial in the context calls `st.session_state["llama_index"].storage_context.persist()` with no arguments, which would also use that default, but it isn't the starter example. [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/putting_it_all_together/q_and_a/terms_definitions_tutorial.md]
